meta.description: Circuits A and B, no offset and offset, in Kickoff 31's 18-circuit order (the wrong-sign variants last), all 27 pairs at once, 8000 shots per circuit.
meta.bit_order: Qiskit bitstrings, rightmost character = classical bit 0; pair i is measured into classical bits 2i (its first qubit) and 2i + 1 (its second)
